chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Ayyūb, from Burayd, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
Regarding a man who forcibly violated a woman’s private part, he said: “He is to be killed, whether he was muḥṣan or not muḥṣan.”

key_terms.فَرْجَهَا: her private part; a legal expression referring to sexual violation
key_terms.مُحْصَنًا: legally married or sexually protected status in penal law

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a man who forcibly violates a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who forcibly violates a woman. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that the punishment is execution, whether the perpetrator is muḥṣan or not, indicating the extreme gravity of this crime in Islamic law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5042 - In the narration of Ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub from Burayd from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), regarding a man who forcibly violated a woman.
Imam (as) said: "He is to be killed, whether he is married or unmarried."
